coverage_override.reason: The three once-per-turn sentences are restrictions attached to the corresponding summon procedure, summon trigger, and negation effect; they are included in those three records rather than counted as separate effects.

effects.printed_clause: If you control a FIRE Dragon monster, you can Special Summon this card from your GY. You can only Special Summon Devotee of Fire once per turn this way.
effects.lua_implementation: An uncopyable GY EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC checks Necrovalley, an open zone, and a face-up FIRE Dragon; its oath count code limits this procedure to once per turn.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a once-per-turn inherent Special Summon procedure from the GY with location/field-state legality checks.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send 1 Dragon monster from your Extra Deck to the GY; Set 1 Spell/Trap that lists Phlogiston Dragon in its text directly from your Deck or GY. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The Normal/Special Summon trigger now sends one Extra Deck Dragon able to go to the GY as REASON_COST before target selection, then at resolution Sets one legal listed Spell/Trap from Deck or Necrovalley-permitted GY. Both summon events share SetCountLimit(1,id).

official_references.matched_structure: Implements a semicolon-positioned Extra Deck send with IsAbleToGraveAsCost and Duel.SendtoGrave(...,REASON_COST) in SetCost.
Uses aux.IsCodeListed to identify cards whose printed text lists a specific named card.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the previous Lua sent the Extra Deck Dragon during resolution with REASON_EFFECT. The semicolon makes that send the activation cost, so it is now paid in SetCost with REASON_COST.

effects.printed_clause: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card or effect, while you control a Phlogiston Dragon (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate that activation. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The opponent Spell/Trap chain condition checks a face-up Phlogiston Dragon, releases Devotee as cost, and negates the activation under a distinct hard once-per-turn code.

official_references.matched_structure: Uses a Tribute/release cost in a chain-response effect and Duel.NegateActivation for the opponent's activation.
